messages:
OpsBot: [ALERT] High write-latency spike detected on kv-proxy (us-east-1). p95 from 120ms -> 850ms over 3m. Paging @Priya :rotating_light:
Priya (on-call): On it. Investigating thread. First check: autoscaler + proxy logs. @Jay can you confirm token queue/backlog?
Jay: seeing token-queue backlog and throttle on dedicated-pool-7. Autoscaler didn't scale up, controller logs show OOM. :eyes:
Maria: I can start a traffic shift to backup-pool-2 to reduce pressure. Will prepare routing change now.
SRE-Lead: Runbook steps: 1) confirm hotspot keys via kvmetrics 2) scale kvproxy 3) shift 20% traffic -> backup pool 4) restart problematic proxy pods if needed.
Alex: running scale command:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment kvproxy-cluster7 --replicas=6
``` 
Starting rollout.
Support: Customer reports: a few enterprise tenants seeing 5-10s latencies, some request timeouts. Preparing status page and customer note.
Priya (on-call): Draft status page blurb — please edit:
"We are investigating elevated inference latency and some timeouts in us-east-1. Our engineers are mitigating by shifting traffic and scaling inference proxies. Some customers may see degraded responses. We will provide updates within 30 minutes."
Kate: Add recommended workaround for Dedicated customers: reduce concurrency or switch to us-west region if possible.
Jay: autoscaler restart initiated, controller OOM disappeared after restart. Monitoring pod memory now.
Maria: started 20% traffic shift. Observing p95 -> 320ms (down from 850ms). :white_check_mark:
Alex: after scale and shift p95 steady ~220-300ms. Error rate falling. Keep monitoring for 15m before declaring mitigated.
SRE-Lead: Agree. If stable 15m, update status page to 'Mitigated — recovery in progress'. Draft customer email template below.
Support: Customer notification (short):
"We experienced elevated inference latency in us-east-1 affecting a subset of requests. We mitigated the issue by shifting traffic and scaling services; performance is recovering. If you still see degraded performance, please contact support@redwood.ai and include request ids."
Priya (on-call): Logging incident timeline and actions into pager duty note. I'll hand off to SRE-Lead for postmortem once incident stabilizes.
SRE-Lead: I'll take postmortem leadership. Thanks team. :bow:
OpsBot: Incident alert closed for paging. Monitor window started. Next check at +15m.
